  WHY: `scan_capped_behind_markers` is not in the poller's RETRY case (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15077), so the verifying run is dropped as terminal after the proving run has already been spent, and the callback marks it handled (15682-15701), so the cycle cannot promote; the D5 purge lets the backlog grow without limit, which makes the boundary realistic; all flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR; minimax_minimax-m3 disputed it as a design observation the plan mandates, not a code defect.

  WHY: A list-only scan that used 19 of the 20 skips leads the verifying dispatch to hit the cap at 20 and return rc 3 (scan_capped_behind_markers); that terminal reason has no retry arm, so the cycle stalls or fails early.
